timeline.label: submit request（提交请求）
timeline.description: viewer validates the selected road scope and queues a background job

timeline.label: create transaction（创建事务）
timeline.description: write an auditable lane upgrade transaction or restore transaction

timeline.label: rebuild lane graph（重建车道图）
timeline.description: rebuild lane centerlines, laneLinks and junction surfaces

timeline.label: run QA gate（运行质量门禁）
timeline.description: evaluate QA reports and package gate status from rebuilt artifacts
timeline.detail: QA gate（质量门禁） manual_review_required / blocker（阻断项） 0

timeline.label: plan propagation（规划传播）
timeline.description: refresh proposal-only lane upgrade propagation candidates
timeline.detail: proposal-only propagation plan（只生成传播建议）

timeline.label: publish package（发布数据包）
timeline.description: publish the next standard LaneForge package and update latest pointer

timeline.label: export SVG QA view（导出 SVG 审查图）
timeline.description: regenerate the SVG review drawing consumed by the live viewer
